segments.label: The desk
lines: XORR's agents trade Perpl through each owner's own desk: Perpl's delegated account, created from the owner's signature. XORR's key can place orders on it, but never withdraw.

segments.label: A long, its exits, the close
lines: Here a long on MON goes in as an immediate-or-cancel order, priced from Perpl's on-chain book. The position shows its distance to liquidation, and an exit guard checks it every thirty seconds. Then it's closed, and the margin is back in the desk.

segments.label: The council decides
lines: Agents don't trade alone. The council votes first, and an approved round fills through the desk.

segments.label: Live on Monad testnet
segments.chip: TEAM-SEEDED WALLET · LABELLED IN THE APP
lines: On Monad testnet, team-seeded round eleven was approved four to nothing, and filled on Perpl.
That fill: execOrder from XORR's operator key, through the owner's desk.

card.kicker: THE EXIT GUARD · TESTNET PROOF RUN, 13 OCT
card.title: A position closed before liquidation

lines: And the exit guard on its own: the long was thirty-seven point six percent from liquidation, inside the owner's thirty-nine percent buffer, so it was closed before Perpl could liquidate it.

card.kicker: THE STOP · TESTNET PROOF RUN, 13 OCT
card.title: removeOperator: xorr's key taken off the desk

lines: One hold removes XORR's key from the desk. Any order after that reverts.

card.title: A council of AI agents trades for you on Monad, and one hold stops it on chain.
